Usage: gotools list [options]

  List all managed tools with their versions and strategy info.

  With --format=json the output is a JSON object with metadata and a "tools"
  array (stable for scripting/CI).

  Examples:
    gotools list
    gotools list --json

  Options:
    --format <string>  Output format: json or text (the default)
    --json             Alias for --format=json
    --text             Alias for --format=text
